svg.title: Your grocery bill has a memory
svg.desc: June 2019 to June 2025: $21.89 becomes $38.61, a change of +$16.73 (+76.4%). Fixed basket: 2 lb Bananas, 2 lb White pan bread, 4 dozen Large grade-A eggs, 1 gallon Whole fortified milk, 4 lb Fresh whole chicken, 1 lb Ground chuck. Illustrative basket using national average prices.
